data.text:
Sachin Kumar vs The State Of Rajasthan ... on 28 May, 2024 
Author: Nupur Bhati
Bench: Nupur Bhati
[2024:Rj-Jd:24404]
 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan At
 Jodhpur
 S.B. Civil Writ Petition No. 8048/2024
1. Sachin Kumar S/o Prithvi Raj, Aged About 26 Years, R/o
 Near Ward No. 14, Court Road, Near Jama Masjid, Tehsil
 Sangaria, Dist Hanumangarh.
2. Dr. Rinet Sonija Dsouza S/o Thomas Dsouza, Aged About
 41 Years, At Present Resident Of Near Ward No. 14, Court
 Road, Near Jama Masjid, Tehsil- Sangaria, District-
 Hanumangarh. 
 ----Petitioners
 Versus
1. The State Of Rajasthan, Through The Secretary To The
 Government, Department Of Medical, Health And Family
 Welfare, Government Of Rajasthan, Secretariat, Jaipur. 
2. Commissioner, Food Safety And Drug Control, Rajasthan,
 Commissionerate, Swasthya Bhawan, Tilak Marg, C-
 Scheme, Jaipur, Rajasthan.
3. Controlling Authority And Drug Controller, Rajasthan Food
 Safety And Drug Control, Commissionerate, Swasthya 
 Bhawan, Tilak Marg, C-Scheme, Jaipur, Rajasthan . 
4. Assistant Drug Controller, Drug Control Office, New Civil  Lines, Hanumangarh (Raj.)
 ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. B.S. Sandhu For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mahaveer Bishnoi, AAG with  Mr. Gaurav Bishnoi  HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE NUPUR BHATI Order 28/05/2024 1. Learned counsel representing the petitioners seeks permission to withdraw the present writ petition with the liberty to file afresh if occasion arises. 
[2024:RJ-JD:24404] (2 of 2) [CW-8048/2024 ]

1 2. Accordingly, the instant writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty. Stay application as well as all other pending applications, if any, also stand dismissed. 
(DR. NUPUR BHATI),J 319-Ravi Khandelwal Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
